description: 20 new context-dependent items; same public minimal-question contract, not a matched-item comparison or verified ground truth.

authoring_brief.goal: Previous items were too easy. Require actual drawing interpretation rather than isolated number reading or naming an obvious solid/dashed stroke. Keep ONE box and a Chinese question <=35 characters. No learner hints, options list, arithmetic operands, or reasoning steps.
authoring_brief.visibility: Visibility means whether the represented geometric edge is visible in the named projection, NOT whether the printed stroke is visible on the page. For real edges ask '框中线表示的边在本视图中是否可见？'. For geometric/non-geometric discrimination ask '框中线表示可见边、不可见边，还是非几何线？'. A centerline, extension line, dimension line, or hatching is NOT an occluded geometric edge. Use concise canonical answers 可见, 不可见, 非几何线 as appropriate. Do not conflate original uncut visibility with visibility after a section cut. Do not ask binary edge visibility of a non-edge without permitting a non-edge answer.
authoring_brief.visibility_aliases: Predeclare only equivalent short terms. 可见 may accept 可见边, 可见轮廓线, 可见的, visible edge. 不可见 may accept 不可见边, 不可见轮廓线, 隐藏边, 被遮挡, hidden edge. 非几何线 may accept 非几何边界, 不代表几何边界, 辅助线. For a binary 是否 question add 是/否 and yes/no to the appropriate class only. Never place competing classes in aliases.
authoring_brief.quality: Use dense, LEGIBLE original PDF drawings and the high-resolution valve sheet. Target one unambiguous segment or feature, leave the surrounding drawing available, and leave clearance between the red rectangle and the stroke. Hardness must come from attachments, continuation, topology, cross-view correspondence, section conventions or dimension composition; never blur, crop away decisive context, select an unreadable character, or rely on obscure standards. Avoid simplistic outer silhouettes and lone dimension numerals. If the requested focus is not supported by the assigned drawing, record uncertainty rather than fabricate geometry. Difficulty is audited independently; a direct local read will be quarantined.
authoring_brief.cross_view: The answer MUST require matching the boxed feature in another clearly identified projection. Name the destination view in the short query when necessary for uniqueness. Never infer hidden 3D topology from appearance alone. Explain the actual correspondence privately.
authoring_brief.section: Prefer unhatched ribs/webs, stepped cuts or continuity across adjacent sections, where absence of hatching alone is misleading. Only use conventions clearly supported by the supplied views. Ask solid/void or connection, not an obscure standards trivia question.
authoring_brief.dimensions: Use at least three DISTINCT labeled operands and at least two arithmetic operations. Each operand must be legible and tied to the target endpoints/datums. Do not invent a third operand by duplicating a label. Avoid simple radius conversion, direct reading, or single subtraction. Keep all operands out of the public query.
authoring_brief.private_evidence: In answer_evidence identify the exact source-specific visual facts, relevant view(s), plausible competing interpretation and why it fails. Record bad_pattern_tags for the tested failure mode. This evidence stays PRIVATE; it is not an instruction to the learner. Labels remain model proposals, not GT.

assignments.focus: Edge visibility in a dense internal feature; contrast with nearby drafting aids, not the previous oil-hole box.
A different feature and view from hard-01; visibility of the represented edge. Seek the opposite visibility class only if genuinely present; never manufacture an answer.
Visible edge versus occluded edge versus non-geometric line: an internal line whose role is established by its continuation/attachments, not stroke appearance alone.
Match a boxed hub/rim/web feature to another projection to determine structural type or visibility there. A local view alone must not suffice.
A line close to a boundary or annotation that requires following its endpoints to distinguish visible geometry, dimension extension, or center marking.
Visibility of an interior geometric edge in one projection; use section/other-view context to distinguish an occluded edge from a visible opening.
Three-way visible/hidden/non-geometric discrimination on a different line and projection from hard-06. Target a drafting aid only if its identity needs attachments/context.
Visibility of an edge near internal passages/overlapping projections. Do not mistake a center marker or a section boundary for the hidden continuation of a hole.
Match a boxed opening/passage across two actual views and judge through/blind or connectivity. Choose a relation that is not directly answerable from the local crop.
Solid/void or passage continuity in a section where local hatch presence/absence is insufficient; require cut/neighboring geometry evidence.
Visibility of a real internal edge in the indicated sectional or ordinary view, respecting the actual cutting condition.
Three-way visible/hidden/non-geometric discrimination on a line distinct from hard-11 and the previous obvious shaft centerline.
Distinguish a real internal contour from slot center/extension/cutting indication using the feature context. Different target from hard-05 and the previous dimension extension.
Match a boxed slot/hole/rib to another view; judge structural shape or whether the corresponding edge is visible there. Specify destination view unambiguously.
Interpret a rib/web or unhatched region using cut direction and continuity, avoiding the old obvious solid box. Do not classify blank paper as a cavity.
Determine a contextual line role at an internal rim/spoke/hub relation or section indication, not another obvious outer silhouette.
Differentiate a contour, center/cutting marker or dimension aid near a dense intersection; box only one legible segment and establish role by context.
Match a boxed valve-body feature across orthographic and sectional views; infer passage/connection or visibility, not a directly printed number.
An unlabelled feature distance requiring at least three distinct dimensions and two operations with checked datums, not single overall-minus-part.
An unlabelled axial or wall/spacing distance requiring at least three distinct dimensions and two operations; disambiguate radius/diameter and endpoints.
